name: Variant A: Functional Hero Summary

copy.headline: Your Relationship Compatibility Blueprint
copy.oneLiner: An analytical breakdown of how your energies interact across five key dimensions — attraction, communication, conflict, rhythm, and long-term potential.
dimensionDescriptions: How your elemental energies draw you together or pull you apart.
How your communication styles align and where misunderstandings arise.
Where friction is most likely and how to navigate it constructively.
Whether your natural paces create harmony or require adjustment.
The structural foundation for growth and commitment over time.
copy.currentWindowText: Your current energetic window favors clarity and alignment. This is an ideal time to assess compatibility with actionable insights.
copy.shareCardText: See our compatibility blueprint — analytical insights into how our energies connect.

reasoning: Functional framing appeals to users seeking practical, outcome-oriented insights. The headline is direct and descriptive, the one-liner sets clear expectations for analytical depth, and the CTA emphasizes value ('Full Analysis') rather than emotional appeal. This variant scores higher on patternClarity and upgradeStrength because it positions the premium report as a necessary tool for understanding relationship dynamics, not just an emotional experience.
